title: Microsoft Surface laptop: unrepairable junk
summary: Louis Rossmann's half-hour teardown criticism of the Microsoft Surface Laptop, arguing its soldered SSD and glued construction make it effectively unrepairable. It ties into his right-to-repair advocacy.
why: HN cites it as evidence that the Surface line is among the least repairable laptops, countering the idea that he only attacks Apple.
